messages.content: I'm planning a trip to Chicago with my family. Can you find attractions kids friendly in that city?

function.name: Flights_4_SearchOnewayFlight
function.description: Search for one-way flights from an origin to a destination on a specific date, with options for seating class and preferred airlines. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

origin_airport.description: The IATA code or the name of the airport or city to depart from.

destination_airport.description: The IATA code or the name of the airport or city to arrive at.

departure_date.description: The start date of the trip in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

seating_class.description: The cabin seat class for the flight.

number_of_tickets.description: The number of flight tickets required for the trip.

airlines.description: Preferred airline for the flight. Use 'dontcare' for no preference.

function.name: Flights_4_SearchRoundtripFlights
function.description: Search for roundtrip flights based on origin, destination, dates, seating class, and other preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

origin_airport.description: The IATA airport code or name of the city to depart from, such as 'JFK' for John F. Kennedy International Airport.

destination_airport.description: The IATA airport code or name of the city to arrive at, such as 'LAX' for Los Angeles International Airport.

departure_date.description: The departure date for the trip in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

return_date.description: The return date for the trip in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

seating_class.description: The class of the cabin seat for the flight.

number_of_tickets.description: The number of flight tickets required for the trip.

airlines.description: Preferred airline for the flight. If no preference, 'dontcare' can be specified.

function.name: Hotels_2_BookHouse
function.description: Book the selected house for given dates and the specified number of adults. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

where_to.description: The location of the house in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

number_of_adults.description: The number of adults included in the reservation.

check_in_date.description: The start date for the reservation, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

check_out_date.description: The end date for the reservation, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

function.name: Hotels_2_SearchHouse
function.description: Search for available houses at a specified location, optionally filtering by amenities such as laundry service and by the number of adults. Results can be sorted by rating. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

where_to.description: The location of the house to search for, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country'.

has_laundry_service.description: Indicates if the house must have laundry service available.

number_of_adults.description: The number of adults that the house needs to accommodate.

rating.description: The minimum review rating (1-5 stars) that the house must have. Use 'dontcare' for no preference.

function.name: Travel_1_FindAttractions
function.description: Retrieves a list of attractions within a specified city, filtered by entry fee, category, and suitability for children. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The name of the city or town where attractions are being searched for, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country'; for example, 'Paris, France' or 'New York, NY'. State names must be abbreviated

free_entry.description: A flag indicating if only attractions with no entry fee should be listed. Use 'True' for free attractions, 'False' for paid, and 'dontcare' for no preference.

category.description: The category of attractions to filter by, such as 'Museum' or 'Park'. The 'dontcare' option includes all categories.

good_for_kids.description: Indicates whether to filter attractions based on their suitability for children. Options are 'True' for child-friendly attractions, 'False' for attractions not suitable for children, and 'dontcare' for no preference.
